collection.title: Aston Martin Vanquish 2012 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Aston Martin Vanquish 2012 - 2018 requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
